title: Library catalog
description: The hand-edited catalog.yaml at the library root. It names the library, sets the license allowlist, and orders the resources. Each resource's facts live in books/<id>/metadata.yaml.

library.description: The only place the library's display names and URLs are written.

name.description: Short machine name of the library.

description.description: One or two sentences that say what the library is.

base_url.description: URL the published site is served from.

repository.description: URL of the library's own source repository.

license_allowlist.description: SPDX ids whose books may be mirrored when the rest of the license gate passes.

resources.description: Resource ids in display order. Each id has a books/<id>/metadata.yaml.

slug.description: Kebab-case slug of lowercase letters and digits.
